t: This is St Dominic's Priory Church, one of the largest Catholic churches in London and a Grade II* listed building. Dominican friars have served it since 1861, living in the priory next door. In October 2016 Cardinal Vincent Nichols inaugurated it as a diocesan shrine, with a mission of promoting the Rosary. Its architect was Gilbert Blount. Before designing churches, he trained as a civil engineer under Isambard Kingdom Brunel on the Thames Tunnel, and once narrowly escaped drowning during one of its floods.
